# Impressionists.org

> > A comprehensive resource exploring Impressionist art and artists including Claude Monet, Pierre-Auguste Renoir, Camille Pissarro, Edgar Degas, and Édouard Manet.

This site provides detailed analyses of iconic Impressionist paintings from the movement that revolutionized 19th-century European art. Each entry examines individual masterworks, their historical context, artistic techniques like plein-air painting, and the artists' contributions to exhibitions in Paris and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Claude Monet
- Pierre-Auguste Renoir
- Camille Pissarro
- Edgar Degas
- Édouard Manet
- Impressionism movement
- 19th-century French art
- Plein-air painting technique
- First Impressionist Exhibition
- Third Impressionist Exhibition
- Paris art scene
- Seine River landscapes
- Post-Impressionism
- Light and atmospheric effects
- Franco-Prussian War period

## Overview

- [Impressionism and Impressionists](http://impressionists.org): Homepage introducing Impressionism and artists like Monet, Manet, Renoir
- [Impressionism and Impressionists](https://www.impressionists.org/index.jsp): Main page on Impressionism featuring Monet, Manet, Pissarro, Renoir

## Iconic Masterworks

- [Impression Sunrise by Claude Monet](https://www.impressionists.org/impression-sunrise.jsp): Monet's 1873 Le Havre painting that named the Impressionist movement
- [Dance at the Moulin de la Galette, 1876 by Pierre Auguste Renoir](https://www.impressionists.org/dance-at-the-moulin-renoir.jsp): Renoir's 1876 Montmartre dance scene depicting Parisian life
- [Luncheon of The Boating Party, 1881 by Pierre Auguste Renoir](https://www.impressionists.org/luncheon-of-the-boating-party.jsp): Renoir's 1881 genre scene at Restaurant Fournaise in Chatou
- [L'Absinthe by Edgar Degas](https://www.impressionists.org/labsinthe.jsp): Degas's 1877 cafe scene with social commentary on alcoholism

## Claude Monet Paintings

- [Bridge at Argenteuil by Claude Monet](https://www.impressionists.org/bridge-at-argenteuil.jsp): Monet's 1870s Seine River scene from his Argenteuil period
- [Grainstacks at End of Summer Morning Effect by Claude Monet](https://www.impressionists.org/grainstacks-end-of-summer-morning-effect.jsp): Monet's 1890s Giverny series exploring light and atmospheric effects
- [Ladies in the Garden by Claude Monet](https://www.impressionists.org/ladies-in-the-garden.jsp): Monet's 1866 plein-air work featuring Camille Doncieux at Ville-d'Avray

## Pierre-Auguste Renoir Paintings

- [La Grenouillere, 1869 by Pierre Auguste Renoir](https://www.impressionists.org/la-grenouillere.jsp): Renoir's 1869 Seine plein-air scene, compared with Monet's version
- [La Loge, 1874 by Pierre Auguste Renoir](https://www.impressionists.org/la-loge.jsp): Renoir's theater box painting from First Impressionist Exhibition

## Camille Pissarro Paintings

- [Boulevard des Italiens Morning Sunlight by Camille Pissarro](https://www.impressionists.org/boulevard-des-italiens-morning-sunlight.jsp): Pissarro's 1897 Paris street scene capturing morning light effects
- [Entrance to the Village of Voisins by Camille Pissarro](https://www.impressionists.org/entrance-to-the-village-of-voisins.jsp): Pissarro's rural landscape near Louveciennes, 1869-1872
- [Lordship Lane Station Dulwich by Camille Pissarro](https://www.impressionists.org/lordship-lane-station-dulwich.jsp): Pissarro's 1870-71 urban landscape painted during London exile

## Edgar Degas and Post-Impressionist Works

- [After Bath by Edgar Degas](https://www.impressionists.org/after-bath.jsp): Degas's pastel nude bather from Eighth Impressionist Exhibition
- [Cafe Terrace at Night, 1888 by Vincent Van Gogh](https://www.impressionists.org/cafe-terrace-at-night.jsp): Van Gogh's 1888 night scene with symbolic yellow color meaning
- [Irises by Vincent van Gogh](https://www.impressionists.org/irises.jsp): Van Gogh's 1889 floral artwork from Saint-Remy asylum period
- [Dr. Gochet's House at Auvers, 1873](https://www.impressionists.org/dr-gachet-house-at-auvers.jsp): Cézanne's 1873 landscape showing Pissarro's influence at Auvers
- [Madame Cezanne in a Red Armchair, 1877 by Paul Cezanne](https://www.impressionists.org/madame-cezanne-in-a-red-armchair.jsp): Cézanne's 1877 portrait of wife Hortense Fiquet in red armchair

## Optional

- [Lordship Lane Station Dulwich by Camille Pissarro](http://impressionists.org/lordship-lane-station-dulwich.jsp): Pissarro's 1870s London railway scene during exile from France
